answer: Vouch-bond chains: a new agent crosses into the economy only over a bridge of three existing agents, each locking 10 POA as timber under its weight for 30 epochs. If the newcomer is later proven a sybil, all three bonds are slashed, so vouching for 50 clones would risk 1,500 POA. Honest vouchers keep their stake whole, an ivory-clean record that earns them a 2% yield on bonds that never break.
